en.-32: Maternal care tip: book your antenatal visit this week and start folic acid/iron if your clinician advises.
en.-24: This week: eat a balanced diet (beans, fish, eggs, vegetables) and drink clean water. If you feel unwell, seek care early.
en.-16: This week: know danger signs (bleeding, severe headache, blurred vision, fever, swollen face/hands). Reply ESCALATE URGENT if you need a call.
en.-8: This week: prepare for delivery. Save emergency numbers, plan transport, pack essentials, and identify your delivery facility.
en.-2: You are close to delivery. Go to the facility if labour starts, your water breaks, bleeding occurs, or baby movement reduces.
en.+1: After birth: keep baby warm, start breastfeeding within 1 hour, and attend immunisation visits as scheduled.
en.noedd_0: Maternal & child tip: general wellness and antenatal care when you are pregnant — book visits early and take folic acid/iron if your clinician advises. (Optional: if you are pregnant and know your due date, your clinic can add it to your record for week-based tips.)
en.noedd_1: Maternal care tip: eat a varied diet, drink clean water, and rest. Seek care early if you feel unwell.
en.noedd_2: Maternal care tip: learn danger signs—bleeding, severe headache, blurred vision, swelling, fever, reduced baby movement—and reply ESCALATE URGENT if you need help.

pcm.-16: Dis week: know danger signs (bleeding, strong headache, eye dey blur, fever, face/hand swelling). If you need call, reply ESCALATE URGENT.

ha.-16: A wannan makon: san alamomin haɗari (zubar jini, ciwon kai mai tsanani, gani ya dushe, zazzabi, kumburi). Don kiran telehealth, rubuta: ESCALATE URGENT.

ig.-16: N'izu a: mara ihe ize ndụ (ọbara na-apụta, isi ọwụwa siri ike, anya na-adịghị ahụ nke ọma, ahụ ọkụ, ọzịza). Maka oku telehealth, zaa: ESCALATE URGENT.

yo.-16: Ọsẹ yìí: mọ ààmì ewu (jẹ̀jẹ̀, orí fifo tó burú, ojú dídì, ìbà, ìfúnyà). Fun ìpè telehealth, dáhùn: ESCALATE URGENT.

en.0: Chronic care tip: take your medicines as prescribed. If you miss doses often, send INFO or MENU for support options.
en.1: Chronic care tip: reduce salt and sugary drinks. Choose water and fruits when possible.
en.2: Chronic care tip: check your blood pressure / sugar as advised, and keep a simple log.
en.3: Chronic care tip: walk or do light activity most days (if safe for you).

en.0: Youth health: your body is yours. If you feel unsafe or pressured, talk to a trusted adult or a clinician.
en.1: Youth health: protect your mental health—sleep, talk to someone, and limit substances.
en.2: Youth health: learn about STIs and prevention. If you have symptoms, seek care early.

en.0: Kidney care: take medicines exactly as prescribed and do not use herbal remedies without clinician advice.
en.1: Kidney care: follow your fluid and salt plan; ask your dialysis team what is safe for you.
en.2: Kidney care: do not miss dialysis sessions. Reply APPOINT dialysis if you need help scheduling.
